旧友の皆さん、こんにちは！楽しい新年をお迎えになったことと思います！

まずは、前回のコミッションの終わり方についてお詫びしたい！その埋め合わせとして、新年を華々しくスタートさせ、皆さんに正当な報酬をお届けしたいと思います！

物事を始めるにあたり、邪悪なオーラ／サイヤ人状態のヘラルの古き良きクラシックなアートを手に入れたかった！あなたのアートはいつも素晴らしいので、全面的に信頼しています。特に、Xに投稿しているここ数回のアートは、あなたがここで何を作ってくれるのか期待しています！

方向性が必要な場合は、フォームの邪悪さと混沌を示すような破壊的なもののどちらかを選ぶと思うが、そうでなければ何でも自由にやってくれ！

新年を皆さんと一緒にスタートできることを心から願っています！

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1fo26ZZ4AbxAmpfRd56C-DwPxcDHDwzXa?usp=drive_link

Long time no see boss! 

I wanted to follow up again to get a rather big commission!

It doesn't really need a background, so your free to color it in or add ki effects if you'd like!

I'd love for you to draw me and my friend in ssj 4! I included below a link with both of our characters, including size measurements and all! Heral is larger then Maha, and Maha is darker skinned then Heral!

If possible, for the clothing, keep the destroyed armor bit on Heral so it shows the chest / stomach, and for Maha make his robes/upper body similar to xenoverse goku when he goes ssj 4 and his clothing kind of folds in!

I look forward to what you'll make!

Yo-Yo! We've been pumping out art of Heral like crazy, so here's for another round!

This time around though, I was thinking perhaps a bit of a break from the crazy power-ups and damaged state, and something more.. Thirst-Trappy? More focused on body anatomy and the character as a whole rather than a specific action!

I was thinking perhaps drawing Heral post-training, all sweaty with his armor and skin-tight taken off but still wearing his Gi-Pants, showing off his muscular physique!

For the background it could be something like a gravity chamber when Goku was going from earth to namek or maybe even the hyperbolic time chamber!

I leave the rest up to you! Pose could be whatever you want, be it either be standing flexing post work out or in the middle of one, whatever you think would show physique best, and for the face, I'd like something that showcases his teeth and fangs, be it a more devious face, happy or annoyed! Looking forward to seeing the results!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SOYCpZM_srQKNPSCAZfoyzQop1uBXBMH?usp=sharing

Hey! It's me again, Father Ulti!

I commissioned you last time to draw my OC, Heral! I came back, and this time with quite a ground-breaking drawing idea!

I want you to draw my OC with battle-damaged clothing which I included some references, with a similar face and pose to the art I will include in the Reference URL Document! 

I want the Face, Aura and Pose similar to the example I sent, however, with the background being the closer-up Oozaru face except colored, similar to the pose & aura reference picture but brown instead of gold with similar aura / ki effects!

I want my OC's hair to be spiking upwards as if he's about to transform into SSJ, except remain black, perhaps with some tints of gold to look as if he's about to release his transformation!

If possible, I'd like his eyes to be red to showcase how he's tapping into this primal Oozaru anger!

You have my full permission to post this wherever too, be it with or without the sample labeling, since I'm positive this will be a crazy good drawing that could go viral! Just make sure to @ my twitter if you do!

Thank you again, and I hope to hear and see back from you soon!
